slots.notes: Fullscreen autoplay/muted/playsInline looping hero background video, object-cover; depicts a phone whose screen the typing-message overlay must register against. Overlaid with a bg-white/5 tint div.

mechanic: A fixed glass-pill navbar over a full-bleed looping phone video, where the serif headline fades-and-scales in, the sub-headline rises, and a Nokia-font typewriter loop with a blinking cursor types/deletes messages pinned onto the phone screen.
techDelivery: React 19 + Tailwind CSS v4 (theme vars + @utility in index.css) + motion/react; single App.tsx holding TypingMessages, Navbar, Hero, App.
reskinNotes: Hero video source URL is hardcoded EXACTLY in markup and the typing-overlay position (left ~48.5%, bottom 32%) is hand-tuned to that specific video's phone-screen placement, so any swapped video must match that framing or the overlay coordinates must be retuned. The Nokia mono font loads from a third-party onlinewebfonts CDN. All hex values and copy (logo 'dot.', nav 'Philosophy/Trust/Access/Tribe', CTA 'Link up', headline, sub-headline, the three typing messages) are baked inline in the component markup. The CTA button glint uses a hardcoded #DEF0FC→transparent gradient rectangle.
